confidence_notes: Coffee, beer and inexpensive meal figures come from one web search of crowd-sourced cost-of-living data for Wellington (MyLifeElsewhere), with snapshots dated July to October 2026. That data put a cappuccino at about NZ$6.06, a domestic pint at about NZ$11.35 and an inexpensive meal at about NZ$24.68. I converted these to USD at the rate implied by the source, about 0.58 USD per NZD. The mid-range meal for two is a model estimate (about NZ$140). Cocktail (about NZ$20) and wine (about NZ$15) were estimated from their usual local price ratio to beer, because I did not search for them directly. Accommodation figures are general-knowledge model estimates, not checked against live listings, and July is the winter low season in Wellington. Accommodation, cocktail and wine figures are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: I took drink and food prices from the Wellington data and checked them against what is typical in Auckland and Christchurch. Accommodation is benchmarked against mid-sized Australian and New Zealand capital cities in the winter shoulder season.
